chunks: From Ibn al-Walid, from al-Saffar, from Ibn Isa, from Ibn Mahbub, from Abdallah ibn Sinan who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: I have mercy on three and they indeed deserve mercy: Ezra, who was struck with humiliation after honor; a rich man, who was struck with need after wealth; and a scholar, who is belittled by his family and the ignorant.

key_terms.عَزِيرٌ: Ezra, a biblical prophet often revered in Islamic tradition

ai.seo_question: Who are the three people Imam al-Sadiq said deserve mercy?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies three categories of people who deserve special mercy: those who fall from high status to humiliation, the wealthy who become poor, and scholars who are looked down upon by their own families and the ignorant. This teaching emphasizes empathy for those experiencing a reversal of fortune or social undervaluation.
